aloud.agree: BiliMind writes down what you say on this computer. The first time, it downloads a speech model{size} and keeps it here. What you say never leaves this computer.
aloud.whichScreen: Which screen are you explaining over? Your voice is recorded with it.
aloud.talk: Talk it through as you would to a classmate. When you stop, your words go into the box.
aloud.done: Your words are in the box. Read them over and fix what it misheard.
aloud.screenFail: This computer won’t share its screen right now.
aloud.recFail: The recorder didn’t start. Try again in a moment.
aloud.noWords: No words came through. Check the microphone, or type it instead.
aloud.writeFail: What you said couldn’t be written down.
aloud.modelProgress: Getting the speech model ready… {done} of {total} MB

tr.progress: Writing the transcript on this computer… {done} of {total} min

err.noMic: This browser can’t use the microphone.
err.denied: BiliMind needs the microphone to record. Allow it in the browser or the computer’s privacy settings, then try again.
err.noMicAnswer: No microphone answered. Check that one is plugged in and not in use.
err.noSound: There was no sound to record.
err.noStart: The recorder didn’t start. Try again in a moment.
